description: Header file defining classes and functions for CRC-based memory copy operations, including architecture-specific optimizations and fallback implementations.

classes.name: CrcMemcpyEngine
classes.description: Abstract base class for CRC memory copy engines with a compute method.

classes.name: CrcMemcpy
classes.description: Provides static methods for CRC memory copy operations, including architecture-specific engines.

classes.name: FallbackCrcMemcpyEngine
classes.description: Fallback implementation of CRC memory copy engine.

classes.name: CrcNonTemporalMemcpyEngine
classes.description: CRC memory copy engine using non-temporal instructions.

classes.name: CrcNonTemporalMemcpyAVXEngine
classes.description: AVX-optimized CRC memory copy engine using non-temporal instructions.

methods.name: CrcAndCopy
methods.description: Performs CRC-based memory copy, selecting architecture-specific engine if available.

methods.name: GetTestEngine
methods.description: Returns an architecture-specific engine for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetArchSpecificEngines
methods.description: Retrieves architecture-specific CRC memory copy engines.

methods.name: Compute
methods.description: Calculates CRC32C checksum while copying memory, implemented in derived classes.
